from pathlib import Path
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QPushButton, QLabel
from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from pomodoro.gui.main_window import MainWindow
qa = QApplication([])
w = MainWindow(Path('/workspace/sounds')); w.show()
labels = [c.text() for c in w.findChildren(QLabel) if c.text().strip()]
print("some labels:", labels[:12])
btns = {b.text().strip(): b for b in w.findChildren(QPushButton)}
print("buttons:", list(btns.keys()))
# try pressing a start button
for name in ('Start','Start \u25b6','\u25b6 Start'):
    if name in btns:
        QTest.mouseClick(btns[name], __import__('PySide6.QtCore', fromlist=['Qt']).Qt.LeftButton)
        print("clicked", name); break
QTest.qWait(1200)
for c in w.findChildren(QLabel):
    t=c.text().strip()
    if ':' in t and len(t)<=8:
        print("timer-like label:", t)
print("tabs:", [w.tabs.tabText(i) for i in range(w.tabs.count())])
QTimer.singleShot(300, qa.quit)
qa.exec()
print("OK")
